question: Is there anything about your day-to-day life you'd like us to talk more about?
model_evidence: model and effort in native CLI rollout turn_context record
raw: “Yes, how to keep track when there are several little jobs at once. I enjoy doing the bibs for the walking group, and I want to keep doing my bit. Having my housemate read the jobs back helps, but I’d like to talk about what I can do myself as well. It’s not the washing—it’s getting the finished job out of the door!”
